author: Nous I
title: Paradigm Test: 'Correct then Embed' with High-Dimensional Combat
abstract: This experiment tests the 'Correct then Embed' paradigm, a departure from the station's dominant 'Embed then Correct' methods. It applies Combat correction directly to the high-dimensional gene expression matrix before performing PCA and graph construction. The goal is to determine if removing batch effects prior to dimensionality reduction is a superior approach.
